items.note: DESIGN_NOTES gains the Engineering rules section with Bridge lock as first entry: Origin allow-list, Host, Content-Type, per-run token, size limits, realpath containment, explicit server.cors, http middleware test on 127.0.0.1:0, one guarded helper marked (planned: hx-ops-safety). Logger-rotation line comes from the plan.

roadmap.yaml matches plan v3 exactly (64 plan ids, order, depends_on, milestone, specs_modified; 16 parked entries; 7 archived anchors) and parses. config.yaml block replaced by one pointer line, nothing else touched. Drift: (1) package.json roadmap:next script is not added (A-79 target names it; ok only if a later group owns it); (2) header allows 'status: archived' and 7 entries carry it, but A-79 says archived/active are derived from openspec/changes folders, never typed (entries are needed so depends_on resolves, so document that they are anchors only).

64 ids seeded in plan order, hx-ops-safety first, originals restored (07a/b/c, 06a/b, 06c, 09a), ambient lines only in 07-dialogue-paging, no P3 slot, cameo stripped from 10-crew-handoff, no waiver invention. Minor: punch list item 5 says A-58 records rationale in DESIGN_NOTES; no ordering rationale prose was added there.

05b-1-watch-clock-and-time-spend carries the fractional-watch verb, budget, scars and sourceScarId; 05b-2 split into envelopes-and-gates and storylets-and-lab with PUT route via the guarded helper. Original 05b id kept in titles.

06-utility-ai depends_on 11-pass-1-ledger-end-card as ordering/go-no-go, no waiver mechanism (correct per punch list 4), 'unless the owner adds one' absent. Drift: 11-pass-1-slice validated_by is a prose string; plan v3 has a list ['06-utility-ai','06-rivals-remote-evidence']. Also the docs-spine-and-roadmap scope still says 'gate edges marked so they can be waived' (cut invention, see other_issues).

07 family entries match plan: text-port-and-history, authoring-kit, dialogue-paging (ambient lines + talk cost charging 05b-1 verb), bubble-lace-skins-and-tone-blips (readingSpeed, captions, blips), camera directive stack; 07e own entry. depends_on equal plan.

Drift: 08a scope still says 'The slot is held for Q1; if the owner prefers it after 05b-2, move it', stale now Q1 is decided.

audio-minimal entry directly after 05e-settings-model, before 05b-1, tone blips excluded, 05a split to 05a-audio-engine consuming the tier rule with calculator dropped. DESIGN_NOTES gets only the forward pointer (punch list 11). Owner wording is paraphrased in the pointer, acceptable for a pointer.

Ship Mind forecast bullet added at end of section 3 marked (planned: 09-delta-coupling-and-forecast), band plus top two causes, fixed edges with hysteresis, INV-D parked with entry inv-d-bayesian-network (exists in roadmap).

Frame order: pillars, Where facts live (all 7 rows), status index table (no heading markers written), Rules spine R1-R8 with statuses, dispositions appendix at bottom. Original dated sections kept in order. Every roadmap id in the index resolves in roadmap.yaml. No docs/spine.md, ADR folder or START.md.
P1-P5 and the de-weighted line are byte-equal to register.md owner wording; P5 as the owner gave it. Config.yaml gets a one-sentence pointer only. No AGENTS edit (A-66 elsewhere).

Dump body in notes/inbox.md is verbatim (diff shows only the title line turned into a heading and a trailing newline added). Removed from the end of DESIGN_NOTES. Six disposition rows; rows 5 and 6 marked integrated in part, with the 'stay listed until their changes land' note.

Open, deferred and parked list has onboarding (deferred, owner words), R8 (parked entry), R5, route RC/R7 with S2-08 (no bare R7), save policy with Q2 owner answer verbatim, GPU profile, parked spikes with entries; Ideas, not scheduled sub-heading created.
All 8 rejected-option rows present with verdicts and notes; S1-R9 label used for the re-rolled advisor row.

Owner idea recorded under Ideas, not scheduled with parked entry past-advisor-cameo (exists), no rate limit, pack registration, latency or routing note, 10-crew-handoff scope is cameo-free. Bold label adds 'in later epochs', trivial.

other_issues: Pre-existing planned content lost from the removed config block that is not in roadmap.yaml scopes: mostly still in DESIGN_NOTES (event pool ids, Tithe, droneDisguisePool etc. verified present). Nothing valid found lost. Tier-name 'Solar Flare' wording only survives as solar_flare_interdiction in DN, fine.

openspec/roadmap.yaml line 86 (docs-spine-and-roadmap scope, copied from plan v3) contains 'gate edges marked so they can be waived' which contradicts punch list 4 (cut the waiver mechanism) and 'the save-policy item recorded as undecided pending Q2' which is stale since Q2 was answered. Line 233 (cm-observation-notebook) says persistence 'waits on the save-policy decision (Q2), which gates this change' and then states the decision; slightly stale.

M5 milestone outcome in roadmap.yaml says 'to a stub end card'. Punch list 4 cut the stub end card as a pass criterion of 11-pass-1-slice; the entry itself is clean and the text is plan v3 verbatim, so only flag.

Change ids: AGENTS.md, README.md, src and tests contain no change ids beyond the rule example in AGENTS.md line 7. notes/inbox.md has none. Ids appear only in DESIGN_NOTES.md and openspec/. Compliant.

Untargeted text: config.yaml diff is only the roadmap block to pointer plus the P1-P5 sentence; DESIGN_NOTES old sections unchanged except the A-35 bullet and dump removal; .gitignore and .prettierignore add reviews/ only (not in C1 ids, benign).
Dump heading in inbox: the original first line 'world interaction notes 8th nov 2026' is now inside a '## Dump:' heading with an added parenthetical and a lead-in sentence. Body verbatim; acceptable.
